_note.en: Design spec §7 verbatim where it has a row; the rest follows its glossary. {n} {name} are substitutions.
_note.zh: 有对应行的地方照抄设计文档 §7；其余遵循同一词表（邀请码 · 主机 · 引擎 · 限额 · 隧道 · 公开网址）。{n} {name} 为替换位。

pop_running_n.zh: 运行中——{n} 位朋友已连接

pop_running_1.zh: 运行中——1 位朋友已连接

pop_stopped_sub.en: Friends can't reach this machine. Their invites work again as soon as you start.
pop_stopped_sub.zh: 朋友现在连不上这台机器。你一启动，他们的邀请码就恢复可用。

pop_offline_sub.en: {kind} at {addr} is not answering. Friends see “engine offline” until it is back.
pop_offline_sub.zh: {addr} 上的 {kind} 没有响应。恢复之前，朋友那边显示“引擎已离线”。

pop_unreachable.en: No answer from the host for {n} s — still trying
pop_unreachable.zh: 主机 {n} 秒没有响应——仍在重试

att_tokens.zh: {name} 已用掉今天 token 的 {p}%

att_tokens_long.en: {name} has used {p}% of today's tokens — {used} of {limit}. Requests are refused once it is used up.
att_tokens_long.zh: {name} 已用掉今天 token 的 {p}%——{limit} 中的 {used}。用完之后请求会被拒绝。

att_public.en: The public URL is on but not connected
att_public.zh: 公开网址已开启，但未连接

att_queue.en: {n} requests are waiting for a slot

fr_title.en: Share the AI on this Mac with friends.
fr_title.zh: 把这台 Mac 上的 AI 分享给朋友。

fr_body.en: Infercat runs a small host on this Mac. Friends open a link you send them and chat with your model. You set the limits, and you can stop any time.
fr_body.zh: Infercat 会在这台 Mac 上运行一个小型主机。朋友打开你发的链接，就能和你的模型聊天。限额由你设定，随时可以停止。

fr_name_hint.en: What your friends see as the host.

fr_foot.en: Nothing is shared until you send an invite.
fr_foot.zh: 在你发出邀请码之前，不会分享任何内容。

fr_noengine.en: No engine found on this Mac.
fr_noengine.zh: 这台 Mac 上没有找到引擎。

fr_noengine_body.en: Infercat shares an engine you already run: Ollama, LM Studio, llama.cpp, llama-swap or vLLM. Start one, then look again.
fr_noengine_body.zh: Infercat 分享的是你已经在运行的引擎：Ollama、LM Studio、llama.cpp、llama-swap 或 vLLM。先启动一个，再重新查找。

fr_nohost.zh: 尚未安装 Infercat 主机。

fr_nohost_body.en: This copy of the app is missing the host it carries. Install Infercat again.
fr_nohost_body.zh: 这份应用里缺少它自带的主机程序。请重新安装 Infercat。

fr_named.en: The host is running, but the name wasn't saved. {reason}
fr_named.zh: 主机已在运行，但名称没有保存。{reason}

fr_first_body.en: Mint an invite and send them the link. They need a browser, nothing else.
fr_first_body.zh: 生成一串邀请码，把链接发给对方。对方只需要一个浏览器。

ov_degraded.en: Friends can reach this machine, but nothing can answer until the engine is back.
ov_degraded.zh: 朋友能连上这台机器，但在引擎恢复之前没有东西可以回应。

err_stopped.en: No host is running for this Mac.
err_stopped.zh: 这台 Mac 上没有正在运行的主机。

err_notanswering.en: The host is running but did not answer in time.
err_notanswering.zh: 主机在运行，但没有及时响应。

err_badcommand.en: The app built a command the host refused: {code}. Please report this.
err_badcommand.zh: 应用构造了主机拒绝的命令：{code}。请反馈这个问题。

err_schema.en: The host speaks schema {n}; this app reads schema 1. Update both to the same version.
err_schema.zh: 主机使用 schema {n}，而这个应用读取 schema 1。请把两者更新到同一版本。

err_oversized.en: The host's answer was too large to read.
err_oversized.zh: 主机的响应太大，无法读取。

banner_stale.en: No answer from the host for {n} s — still trying.
banner_stale.zh: 主机 {n} 秒没有响应——仍在重试。

stop_title_n.en: Stop the host while {n} friends are connected?
stop_title_n.zh: 有 {n} 位朋友正连接，仍要停止主机吗？

stop_title_1.en: Stop the host while 1 friend is connected?
stop_title_1.zh: 有 1 位朋友正连接，仍要停止主机吗？

stop_body.en: {names} will be disconnected. Requests in flight get up to 10 s to finish. Their invites work again when you start.
stop_body.zh: {names} 会被断开。进行中的请求最多有 10 秒完成。你重新启动后，他们的邀请码就恢复可用。

soon_invite.en: New invite comes in the next build. Open the web console to mint one now.
soon_invite.zh: 生成邀请码将在下个版本推出。现在可以用网页控制台生成。

soon_body.en: This build has the menu-bar item, first run and Overview. Until {screen} lands, the web console already does everything this screen will.
soon_body.zh: 这个版本包含菜单栏图标、首次启动和概览。在{screen}推出之前，网页控制台已经能完成这个界面将要做的一切。

mb_running_n.zh: Infercat — 运行中，{n} 位朋友已连接

mb_running_1.zh: Infercat — 运行中，1 位朋友已连接

mb_running_0.zh: Infercat — 运行中，没有人连接
